reviews.text: Excellent service and high-quality veterinarians

Doctors Bruyères and Tasté saved our little Anna; their welcome and kindness are ever-present.
Thank you again.

We would like to sincerely thank Dr. Fernandez, who was incredibly empathetic, caring, and professional during our emergency consultation on Saturday morning at 4:00 AM. Our dog was in complete shock, tachycardic, and hypothermic at 36°C. Since our dog needed to be hospitalized at the Veterinary School, I want to emphasize that she provided the hospital team with all the information she had even before our arrival, which greatly facilitated the rest of his care. She also gave us hot water bottles for the journey. Dr. Fernandez helped make this horrific evening less difficult, and we are extremely grateful for her comprehensive care! We have absolutely no complaints.

Unrivaled in Paris

Dr. Violé is extremely professional.

Thank you so much.
Excellent welcome, lovely and peaceful setting, very friendly and professional veterinarian, I recommend without reservation!

I've known Isabelle for almost twenty years now (already!), and once you try her, you're hooked! She's available, competent, and very compassionate. The only vet I trust completely. Cannelle was right about her too, which is why we came all the way from Issy-les-Moulineaux.

Today, I want to express my sincere gratitude to Dr. Kitsos for patiently and successfully removing the entire garbage ligature that little Crush had swallowed using an endoscopy. It's such a shame that the very unpleasant receptionist misrepresented my words and felt attacked for no reason; otherwise, I could have thanked Dr. Kitsos in person! So, I'm doing it this way.
Veterinarians who are truly attentive to the well-being of animals.

Avoid at all costs. I brought my cat in with a broken leg, and after two botched surgeries, I discovered that his opposite paw pads had been cut until they bled during the nail trimming—a fact they had shamefully concealed. They had promised a strong support bandage to give the second surgery every chance, but nothing was applied. Worse still, the clinic I took him to asked if I knew a bone in his opposite leg was broken and displaced. How can a cat with two broken opposite legs stand without support? Vetinparis dared to claim that the botched surgeries were solely my cat's fault; they never mentioned that my cat bled from his paw pads, even though it took over a month to heal. It ended in amputation because the surgeon at the new clinic had told me about a method to save his leg, but he called the first surgeon, whom he knew, who assured him that he had to use the same method as him, so he too didn't apply the requested bandage. It was the last-ditch operation, and vetinparis, by interfering, left him no chance. It ended in amputation because he couldn't be operated on indefinitely; only then did the second surgeon take an X-ray of the opposite leg without revealing his reasoning and asked me if I knew that a metatarsal bone was fractured and displaced. In seven days, my cat went through hell. The first surgeon only called me after the amputation, never before. I thought a veterinary student had botched my cat, but no, it was professionals who mutilated him. And he thought it wise to add that vets know ginger and tortoiseshell cats are difficult, so I asked, devastated, why he hadn't applied the promised bandage. My cat came back anorexic, prostrate under my duvet, and refused to drink water for 50 days. I woke up three times a night trying to give him pureed wet food to save him. I contacted their liability insurance, but none of them had the decency to read the complete file to answer my questions. Vetinparis never sent me an invoice; they even offered the second surgery for free. I paid to get my cat out and only have the initial estimate, damning proof of their awareness of their liability. Today, after an attempt at mediation at my request, neither Vetinparis nor the other clinic bothered to come. They are therefore forcing him to go to court so that no other animal ever has to endure this ordeal and so that this case can be brought to justice. I am disgusted to learn of Vetinparis's mentality and lack of respect. When I took my cat out, his body riddled with fractures from botched procedures and undisclosed injuries, I was horrified to see his pitiful state. I didn't want to leave a review because I hoped they would acknowledge their mistakes, negligence, and responsibility, but since I don't have insurance for my cat, it's a David and Goliath situation, and I cannot accept it. Every animal deserves to be treated with dignity. (In response to your reply: the mediator issued a "statement of non-compliance" because you did not attend. He called you, but you refused to speak with me. The expert from your professional liability insurance provided no explanation for the broken opposite metatarsal, nor for the mutilated, bleeding paw pads that left my cat unable to stand on two healthy legs, making it impossible. I note that, following this belated post, you are finally showing concern for the case, despite all my requests since the events of 2024.)

Thank you so much.
Sincerely,
Dr. Isabelle Pasquet

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We are absolutely delighted with this veterinary clinic! ❤️

We saw Dr. Martinot for our little ferret, Alvin, and we were very pleased with her care. She's a fantastic vet, very gentle, attentive, and truly reassuring. She takes the time to answer all our questions, explains everything clearly, and even scheduled another appointment for Alvin's follow-up.

We also want to thank the reception staff. The first woman I spoke to on the phone when Alvin's ears were bleeding and he was scratching a lot was very kind and responsive. She offered us an appointment right away that afternoon, which was really reassuring.

We then spoke with a second receptionist, with short hair and a blonde streak, who was also lovely and very kind when we scheduled our second appointment. We truly appreciated their warm welcome and kindness.

The clinic is also very beautiful and pleasant, especially the area where the animals are received, which is really lovely and reassuring.

Thank you to the whole team for your kindness, attentiveness, and care towards our little Alvin. 🐾❤️

A professional, available, and attentive team. From the veterinarians to all the staff. For a month, they did everything possible to save our rabbit, Caramelle. They were very caring with the animal, especially Dr. M., and they were very helpful in explaining things to her owners. Unfortunately, the outcome was tragic; this in no way diminishes what has been written above.

Thank you
Still exceptional.
Appointment for a 6 1/2 year old cat, blood test, examination, with Dr. Amandine Violé - everything was perfect - I recommend this veterinary clinic.

Thank you so much for your feedback.
Best regards, Isabelle Pasquet, DV for Vetinparis

Thank you so much for your feedback.
Best regards, Isabelle Pasquet, DV for Vetinparis
Good place got our paper work done here so we could take dog back to the uk.  Fast service can’t fault it

Dr. Chavaux was so kind and caring towards my dog and towards me, as I was very frightened during the procedure with anesthesia. She took the time to explain everything and to keep me updated to help ease my anxiety. Such a great doctor, I was so thankful for her!

Thank you so much for your feedback.

Sincerely,
Dr. Isabelle Pasquet for VETINPARIS

The welcome was perfect, the emergency care perfect, the location perfect (the smell of the premises made us feel like we were on vacation 🥰), and the follow-up impeccable.

I would especially like to thank Dr. Hawawini, who was incredibly professional. He immediately diagnosed my cat's problem, which had caused him suffering during the heatwave, and he knew how to put us at ease.
He is a very kind, attentive, and, above all, accommodating person. You can tell he loves his work.
Thank you so much; my cat recovered thanks to you.

Ms. Conde,
After checking our records, we have no file corresponding to your name.

Sincerely,
Dr. Isabelle Pasquet for VETINPARIS

This clinic is very caring and attentive to its patients.

All the staff, including the veterinary assistants and veterinarians, always greet you with a smile. The animals are well cared for, and their responsiveness in case of complications is excellent.

I highly recommend them! 🥰

Talented and caring veterinarians and professionals, a warm welcome, excellent! Many thanks to the entire team, and especially to Dr. Masson who saved AKo and Dr. Samyde for his invaluable advice. Perfect 💖🙏

I want to thank from the bottom of my heart the entire team at VetinParis who saved my little kitten Mino, who was only 5 months old. ❤️

She was in critical condition after contracting feline panleukopenia (feline distemper), calicivirus, and several other viruses. Despite the seriousness of her condition, the team fought for her with great professionalism, kindness, and care.

Today, my little Mino is still with us, and I am eternally grateful. 🙏🐱❤️

I can't thank you enough. ❤️
Our rabbit Praline is so lucky to be treated by Dr. Sarah Samyde, who is always available, attentive, and so professional! Looking forward to the next appointment ;-)

My lop rabbit, Oreo, came in as an emergency and was treated there. I want to sincerely thank Dr. Sara Samyde, who made the correct diagnosis. She was kind, attentive, and extremely professional. She monitored Oreo's progress and interpreted his ultrasound at a later appointment. I also thank Dr. Sylvain Hawawini, who performed the ultrasound and urine sample with such gentleness and kindness towards Oreo. Furthermore, the clinic is welcoming: the receptionists, the veterinary assistants, the facilities. I visited Oreo during his hospitalization; everything was done to ensure I could spend time with him, and I can tell you that the animals are very well cared for with everything they need! One word: THANK YOU!

I highly recommend them!!!!!
True professionals!
Exceptional sound quality!!!!

Everything here is meticulously planned, processed, and organized to maximize billing. €850 for one night of observation and a few tests on my cat. No explanation the next day other than "we'll call you with the test results." I didn't receive a call, but an email stating that the results were inconclusive and that a scan was necessary. I called the switchboard for further clarification but never received an answer. A second, independent opinion told me that the test results were very clear and that, unfortunately, any further testing would be pointless. Avoid at all costs.
This cut-rate vet killed my cat, even though I told him he wouldn't survive the anesthesia; he insisted. He only cares about money and couldn't care less about animal welfare.

If you and your NAC pet are going to this veterinary hospital, it is strongly recommended that you carefully select your veterinarian. My guinea pig sought help at this hospital after getting sick, but unfortunately, we encountered a young, unprofessional, inexperienced, and arrogant veterinarian. She wouldn't even use the term "bonjour." This young veterinarian required my pig to be hospitalized for a week, but seeing that my pig's condition was poor after hospitalization, I insisted on discharge and take it to another veterinary hospital, where it recovered quickly without needing hospitalization. I initially thought it was just bad luck, given the hospital's high ratings! However, a few months later, another guinea pig owner I knew told me that their pig had been misdiagnosed with a serious eye problem by the same veterinarian and required expensive treatment (but the guinea pig recovered on its own after two days). We discussed this in a guinea pig group and discovered that we weren't the only ones who had encountered problems here; another owner said their pig had surgery here and died after returning home.

Objectively speaking, the hospital environment is good, the receptionist is professional and friendly, the nurses are responsible, and another NAC veterinarian (who appeared slightly older) demonstrated professionalism when processing my pig's discharge. However, I would not recommend that young NAC veterinarian at all; her skills and attitude do not meet the requirements of a qualified veterinarian!

Thank you so much for your feedback.
Best regards, Dr. Isabelle Pasquet for VetinParis
A friendly and competent young team!

Unfortunately, I had to hospitalize my Suzette at VetinParis over the weekend of August 15th.

I don't remember the name of the on-call vet, but I thank her for her clear and precise explanations. A special thank you to Dr. Chauveau for the care she provided, her advice, her patience, and her gentleness with Suzette until the very end 💔 and for her kindness to me.
A vet who has been treating my bunnies for a long time. Fair prices, specialized, honest, and competent vets. Thank you for everything you do for my little bunnies 🫶

Dr. Samyde has been treating my guinea pigs for over 10 years. She is a passionate and highly skilled veterinarian. She loves animals and her work, and I trust her completely.

From 2019 to 2026, she cared for my wonderful Foxy, who had numerous health problems. Despite his difficulties, he lived to be seven and a half years old, thanks to the care of a dedicated and caring team of professionals who expertly managed emergencies, hospitalizations, and long-term care.
A huge thank you to the entire NAC team; I highly recommend them for your pets.

Thank you so much for your kind words, which we greatly appreciate.

Sincerely, Dr. Isabelle Pasquet for Vetinparis

A passionate and dedicated team.
The clinic is beautiful.

Excellent veterinary clinic!
My cat received perfect care.

Dear Sir/Madam,

We are unable to identify your file.

We remain available should you wish to contact us.

Sincerely,

Dr. Isabelle Pasquet for VETINPARIS

Thank you so much.
Sincerely,
Dr. Isabelle Pasquet

This is my cat's veterinary practice, which I've recommended to everyone I know because we're always warmly welcomed, their explanations are always clear, and they always answer our questions. Animal welfare is paramount to them, and it shows. Even though my cat gets very stressed during the emergency visits I've had to make, they are always empathetic towards both the animal and the owner. Thank you to them for always being so kind.
I had an appointment with Mr. Menard and I can only recommend his professionalism and kindness towards our pet at the end of its life. I highly recommend him.

A wonderful clinic. We've been coming here since it opened and are so fortunate that all our cats—those who have been with us over the years and those who share our lives today—have been or are being treated by Dr. Pasquet.

She has always demonstrated remarkable accuracy in her diagnoses, with attentive care deeply focused on the well-being of our animals. Consultations always take place in a calm and welcoming atmosphere, which is especially appreciated when you come with your pets.

Of course, we've experienced difficult, even distressing, times when the news wasn't good. In these circumstances, Dr. Pasquet has always combined great professionalism with attentive listening, sensitivity, and compassion.

It's no coincidence that we travel from the west of Paris to see her: we have complete confidence in her and in this clinic. And for our cats, we wouldn't go anywhere else.

Excellent welcome, calm, attentive, and caring. The place is lovely, well laid out, and you can feel the pleasant atmosphere, with the added bonus of on-site parking. I went there for one of my cats who was very ill, in the advanced stages of cancer, and the care was excellent considering the situation, without excessive tests or charges. I highly recommend this place, and if I needed it again, this is where I would go.
Perfect for NAc emergencies

Excellent vets!
Dr Pasquet and her team are just brilliant!
They treat both our pets and us very well.
The vet practice is always very clean and it is one of the best equipped in Paris.
Always open. Do not hesitate to go there. They always do their best to cure/relieve our beloved pets !
Perfect, my dog ​​was well received, thank you

I would like to sincerely thank Dr. Pasquet, who has been Akina's veterinarian since she was born. She is an exceptional veterinarian, passionate about her work and deeply committed to animal welfare.

Over the years, she has always been there for Akina, attentive and available, both for her and for me. You can immediately feel her love for animals and her dedication. She takes the time to explain, reassure, and support with great kindness.
I particularly appreciate her honesty: she doesn't push unnecessary treatments, and her advice is always given with the animal's best interests at heart.
Thank you for your kindness, professionalism, and dedication. Akina is very lucky to have a veterinarian like you.

July 30, 2016
The team and Dr. Hawawini did everything they could to take care of our 15-day-old kitten. She was pampered as much as possible. A huge thank you.

June 24, 2025
The team and Dr. Hawawini did everything they could to ensure the visit for our three babies went as smoothly as possible, despite the heat outside. Romy was spayed, Raven received her vaccination, and Thalassa had her pregnancy ultrasound. Everything was done to ensure they were in the best possible conditions and to minimize stress. A huge thank you again to everyone.

August 4, 2024
Thank you again for your dedication. A whole day was spent with our first-time mother, Thalassa, who was 68 days pregnant. Five beautiful babies arrived after wonderful collaboration between her and the veterinarian who was with her all day and kept us informed of each birth. Thank you also to our regular veterinarians who, despite being on vacation, supported us throughout this long day and are always available, no matter the day or time.

Once again, a HUGE THANK YOU to everyone.

Top-notch reception and veterinary services. I recommend them to all my adopters in the Paris region. Thank you to the entire team for their dedication to our babies.

October 15, 2025

Always a perfect welcome. Immediate help for the babies and their mother after an incident during transport. A huge thank you to the veterinary nurses and especially to Estelle for her intervention. As for the visit with Dr. Pasquet, it's always a pleasure to see her. Thank you all, and see you soon.

We are delighted with this veterinary clinic; the staff are very attentive to our British Shorthair cats. We come regularly for various treatments and procedures. Thank you to Dr. Pasquet and his colleagues for their care. Gaëtan from the Mamacats cattery
Warm welcome, good communication, respectful of the animal, quick emergency care on a Saturday night.

Excellent veterinary clinic! My two dogs are always well cared for thanks to Dr. Ferembach. One of them had surgery for cancer and is now perfectly healthy.

I've had to go there several times for emergencies, and the reception is always reassuring despite the stress involved. The hospitalization process was excellent; they saved my little retired dog who arrived in critical condition due to hemorrhagic gastroenteritis that caused rapid dehydration. We are always warmly welcomed, and it's easy to book an appointment online.

Thank you so much for this feedback.
Dr. Isabelle PASQUET for VETINPARIS

It's teeming with vets 💪💪💪 a beehive of activity, and Laura at reception goes above and beyond to answer all your questions.
A HUGE THANK YOU ♥️

I was glad I was able to get my dog ​​treated at a 24-hour clinic.
However, the vet forgot the medication when I paid and closed the file. It wasn't a problem for me; everyone makes mistakes, and he was competent and pleasant.

On the other hand, it took two hours round trip to pick up the medication, leaving my little dog feeling unwell all alone. When I arrived, it wasn't ready, contrary to what I had been told. We searched... it took forever... finally, it was there. I asked twice if I had everything. When I got home, I didn't have a measuring cup for the medication. I called to try to find out how to calculate the quantity. The response was a limp, "Oh yes, I should have given you a measuring cup, but don't you have a pharmacy near you?" I would have appreciated a little more focus and professionalism, especially for something as simple as this.

My experience at this clinic left a deep impression on me, and several years later, I still haven't forgotten it.

I went there as an emergency because my dog, Roucky, was shaking his head due to a foxtail in his ear. A young veterinarian was on call alone that night. During the initial assessment, several attempts were made to insert a catheter, which required shaving both of his paws, but without success. My dog ​​was then given sedatives by injection, but he became increasingly stressed and terrified (he's usually a calm dog, even at the vet's). I was also very shocked by the attempt at gas anesthesia in a large plastic tub while my dog ​​was howling. Despite this, he couldn't be put to sleep, and his ear ultimately couldn't be examined or treated. I left around 2 a.m. with a dog who couldn't stand, both paws shaved, still in pain from his ear, and deeply traumatized by the treatment.

I should mention that he's a small Pomeranian, usually very calm and sociable. This experience was extremely difficult for both him and me. Looking back, I regret not leaving earlier to seek a second opinion elsewhere.

I understand that veterinary emergencies can be complex. Nevertheless, this treatment did not inspire confidence and left a very painful memory. That's why I'm surprised to see the excellent ratings for this clinic, as they don't reflect my personal experience at all.

Thank you so much for your feedback.
Best regards, Dr. Isabelle Pasquet for VETINPARIS

I have a great experience with Vetinparis each time I take my cat there.
Dr. Hawawini is very professional and kind, and takes time to reassure me about my cat’s health and to answer all my concerns!
Recommended 10/10!
